subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: MySpace: The First Social Giant
description: A micro-lesson that makes MySpace: The First Social Giant usable.

hook.text: MySpace launched in 2003 and let users customize profiles with their own HTML and CSS.

buildup.text: Bands uploaded music, teens built digital identities, and the site hit 100 million users.

discovery.text: MySpace taught a generation that the web was personal — your profile was your digital home.

twist.text: News Corp bought MySpace for $580 million. Poor management drove users straight to Facebook.

climax.text: MySpace proved social networks could be massive — and that corporate owners could destroy them.

punchline.text: The first social giant fell to bad management.

quiz.question: What made MySpace unique?
options: Users could customize profiles with HTML
